records.question: I want to go to Account Settings, Subscription, then Cancel Plan -- what happens after that?
records.answer: After you cancel your plan through Account Settings > Subscription > Cancel Plan, your cancellation will be effective at the end of your current billing cycle. Please note that there are no partial refunds for the remaining days. Additionally, your customer data will be retained for 90 days should you choose to reactivate your account. After those 90 days, all data is permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
